The (dominantly) shifted twisted Yangian associated to the matrix $\sigma$ and the composition $\mu$ is the algebra ${\mathscr{Y}}_{\mu}^{+}(\sigma)$ generated by

$\{H_{a;i,j}^{(r)},\widetilde{H}_{a;i,j}^{(r)}\}_{1\leqslant a\leqslant n,1\leqslant i,j\leqslant\mu_{a},r\geqslant 1},\quad\{B_{a;i,j}^{(r)}\}_{1\leqslant a\mathfrak{s}_{a+1,a}(\mu)}$

subject to the relations (4.1)–(4.9) with all admissible indices together with the following relations (cf. Remark 4.2)

(8.3)

$Z_{a;i,i,j,j}^{(2r-1)}=0, 1\leqslant a

By Theorem 4.1, if $\sigma$ is the zero matrix, then ${\mathscr{Y}}_{\mu}^{+}(\sigma)$ is exactly ${\mathscr{Y}}_{N}^{+}$. Clearly, we have the canonical homomorphism ${\mathscr{Y}}_{\mu}^{+}(\sigma)\to{\mathscr{Y}}_{N}^{+}={\mathscr{Y}}^{+}_{\mu}$ sending the generators $H_{a;i,j}^{(r)}$ and $B_{a;i,j}^{(r)}$ of ${\mathscr{Y}}_{\mu}^{+}(\sigma)$ to elements of ${\mathscr{Y}}_{N}^{+}$ with same names.

In the rest of this subsection, we shall prove that this homomorphism is injective and its image is independent of the particular choice of the admissible shape $\mu$.

For $1\leqslant a\mathfrak{s}_{b,a}(\mu)$, define elements $B_{b,a;i,j}^{(r)}$ inductively by

(8.4)

$B_{a+1,a;i,j}^{(r)}:=B_{a;i,j}^{(r)},\quad B_{b,a;i,j}^{(r)}:=[B_{b-1;i,k}^{(\mathfrak{s}_{b,b-1}(\mu)+1)},B_{b-1,a;k,j}^{(r-\mathfrak{s}_{b,b-1}(\mu))}],$

cf. Lemma 3.4. Again, the definition is independent of the choice of $k$. Recall the twisted current algebra $\mathfrak{gl}_{N}[z]^{\theta}$ which has a basis

$\big\{e_{ij}\otimes z^{r}-(-1)^{r}e_{ji}\otimes z^{r}\big\}_{1\leqslant j\leqslant i\leqslant N,r\in\mathbb{N}}\setminus\{0\}.$

Under the assumption (8.1), the vectors

$\{e_{ij}\otimes z^{r}-(-1)^{r}e_{ji}\otimes z^{r}\}_{1\leqslant j

span a subalgebra of $\mathfrak{gl}_{N}[z]^{\theta}$, and call it the shifted twisted current algebra. We denote this subalgebra by $\mathfrak{gl}_{N}[z]^{\theta}(\sigma)$. The universal enveloping algebra $\mathrm{U}(\mathfrak{gl}_{N}[z]^{\theta}(\sigma))$ has a natural grading induced from the grading on $\mathfrak{gl}_{N}[z]$, which places $xt^{r}$ in degree $r$.

paper.title: Shifted twisted Yangians and finite $W$-algebras of classical type
paper.abstract: We introduce parabolic presentations of twisted Yangians of types AI and AII, interpolating between the R-matrix presentation and the Drinfeld presentation. Then we formulate and provide parabolic presentations for the shifted twisted Yangians. We define quotient algebras known as truncated shifted twisted Yangians and equip them with baby comultiplications, generalizing the work of Brundan and Kleshchev. PBW bases for all (truncated) shifted twisted Yangians of type AI and AII are established along the way. Applying the theory of universal equivariant quantizations of conic symplectic singularities we show that the truncated twisted shifted Yangian is isomorphic to the finite $W$-algebra which quantizes a suitable Slodowy slice. This provides a presentation of the finite $W$-algebra associated with every even nilpotent element in type {\sf B} and {\sf C}, as well as every nilpotent element with two Jordan blocks in type {\sf D}. Finally we make a conjecture which would supply presentations in the remaining even cases in type {\sf D}.
